docstring: Yield orders whose status matches status. Implement the original requested behavior and respect the supplied lazy-generator tests. Return a consistently indented Python method body only.

User-approved clarification resolving the original description/test conflict: follow the supplied test_contains_present_even_if_zero_on_hand_after_commit. A normalized SKU remains a member once recorded in the on-hand ledger, even when a full commit reduces its quantity to zero. Invalid/non-string inputs and valid but never-stocked SKUs are not members. Do not require positive remaining quantity, and do not change any tests.
